dataset.description: Fixed fictional development benchmark: Italian personal archive, near duplicates, temporal versions, exact identifiers, multilingual queries, typos, multi-relevant labels, tags, long text and unanswerable queries. Hand-authored labels; not an independent or real-user test set. Frozen before the first benchmark run.
